problem.passage:
Consider the system of equations shown.

y = 3x - 10
y = 2x - 6

What is the y-intercept of the line represented by the second equation shown?
problem.stimulus:
Consider the system of equations shown.

y = 3x - 10
y = 2x - 6
problem.question: What is the y-intercept of the line represented by the second equation shown?
problem.explanation: 두 번째 식(y = 2x - 6)의 형태에서 상수항이 y절편이므로 y절편은 -6이다.
problem.explanationEn: In the second equation (y = 2x - 6), the constant term is the y-intercept, so the y-intercept is -6.
